objects.name: Detection technique coverage: set-default-powershell-execution-policy-to-unrestricted-or-bypass
objects.description: The following analytic detects changes to the PowerShell ExecutionPolicy in the registry to "Unrestricted" or "Bypass." It leverages data from Endpoint Detection and Response (EDR) agents, focusing on registry modifications under the path *Software\Microsoft\Powershell\1\ShellIds\Microsoft.PowerShell*.
